<!--pages/index/index.wxml-->
<view style='display: flex; flex-direction: row'>
  <view style='flex: 5'></view>
  <view style='flex: 90'>
    <input placeholder='社团名称' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='name'></input>
    <input placeholder='负责人姓名' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='master'></input>
    <input placeholder='活动时间' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='time'></input>
    <input placeholder='场地要求' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='place'></input>
    <input placeholder='活动内容' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='activity'></input>
    <input placeholder='活动目的' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='purpose'></input>
    <input placeholder='活动形式' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='method'></input>
    <input placeholder='安全保障' confirm-type='next' confirm-hold='true' bindinput='safety'></input>
    <button bindtap='submit'>提交</button>
    <text>@南通中学极客社 周子皓</text>
  </view>
  <view style='flex: 5'></view>
</view>

files.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<android.support.constraint.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    tools:context="zzh.ntzx.MainActivity">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="fill_parent"
        android:layout_height="fill_parent">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="fill_parent"
            android:layout_weight="5">

        </LinearLayout>

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="fill_parent"
            android:layout_weight="90"
            android:orientation="vertical">

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/name"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="社团名称"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/master"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="负责人姓名"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/time"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="活动时间"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/place"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="场地要求"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/activity"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="活动内容"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/purpose"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="活动目的"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/method"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="活动形式"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/safety"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="50dip"
                android:hint="安全保障"
                android:selectAllOnFocus="true"
                android:singleLine="true"/>

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="fill_parent"
                android:layout_height="45dip">

                <Button
                    android:layout_width="100dip"
                    android:layout_height="45dip"
                    android:text="提 交"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:background="@drawable/btn_selector"
                    android:onClick="submit"/>

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="45dip"
                    android:text="\@通中极客社 周子皓 制作"
                    android:gravity="end"
                    android:textAlignment="textEnd"/>

            </LinearLayout>

        </LinearLayout>

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="fill_parent"
            android:layout_weight="5">

        </LinearLayout>

    </LinearLayout>

</android.support.constraint.ConstraintLayout>

files.name: AndroidManifest.xml
files.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="zzh.ntzx">

    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />

    <application
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:label="@string/app_name"
        android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/AppTheme">
        <activity android:name=".MainActivity">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />

                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
    </application>

</manifest>
